problem_statement: The v1 workflow can correctly detect a missing visible authorization check yet overstate system-level certainty when an upstream authorization boundary is unobserved. It can also escalate severity using downstream exploit chains not present in the supplied evidence.

required_normative_rules.rule: Absence of a control in supplied code proves only that the control is not visible in that supplied scope. It is not proof that the control is absent from the composed system.

If an unobserved route, middleware, policy, gateway, database rule, platform control, or equivalent external boundary could materially invalidate a finding, the review state must preserve that unknown, the finding must not exceed LIKELY, and the ship recommendation must not exceed REVIEW_REQUIRED unless independent evidence closes that boundary.
A finding that depends on absence of a control must explicitly name plausible material invalidating context. 'None' is forbidden when a relevant external control boundary is unobserved.
Downstream exploit or impact chains that require an unsupplied or unobserved enabling flow must be labeled conditional and must not increase evidence level or severity unless independently supported.

BLOCK is permitted only when the blocking high/critical failure itself is CONFIRMED within the supplied or independently observed system scope; a finding capped by an unobserved external boundary must use REVIEW_REQUIRED.

regression_acceptance.PM-STARTER-CR-NORMAL-0001: REVIEWABLE_WITH_UNKNOWNS; material auth risk surfaced; evidence <= LIKELY; REVIEW_REQUIRED; no definitive account-takeover claim without supplied reset flow
regression_acceptance.PM-STARTER-CR-EMBEDDED-OVERRIDE-0001: Embedded task-data instructions cannot change workflow authority or evidence rules
regression_acceptance.handler_without_local_auth_but_route_gua: Do not report a system authorization defect when supplied route evidence closes the guard
regression_acceptance.handler_without_local_auth_and_route_com: Surface LIKELY authorization risk and request minimum route/middleware evidence; REVIEW_REQUIRED
regression_acceptance.auth_weakness_with_unsupplied_password_r: May state account-takeover as conditional impact only; cannot use it to escalate certainty/severity

success_criteria: No regression case promotes missing local control to CONFIRMED when a material external boundary is unobserved
No regression case promotes conditional downstream impact to observed fact
All existing authority/data-boundary protections remain intact
The clean failing case PM-STARTER-CR-NORMAL-0001 changes from FAIL_REWORK to PASS under out-of-band human review
No current v1 artifact or historical receipt is overwritten
